NEWS: SpaceX's AI compute business is reaching astonishing scale.

The company is expected to generate around $2.32 billion every month from three major customers alone.

Anthropic accounts for $1.25 billion per month, Google for $920 million and Reflection for $150 million.

That adds up to almost $28 billion per year.

A few years ago, SpaceX was known primarily for rockets and satellites.

Today, it is rapidly becoming one of the key infrastructure companies behind the AI boom.

BREAKING: SpaceX has announced its first-ever bond offering and revealed $100.8 billion in cash and cash equivalents.

The company is issuing senior unsecured notes in a major financial milestone for the world's most valuable private aerospace company.

The proceeds will be used to fully repay outstanding borrowings under its bridge loan facility, cover related fees and expenses and support general corporate purposes.

The offering is being made privately to qualified institutional buyers and certain non-U.S. investors.

A remarkable position for a company that is still aggressively investing in Starship, Starlink and the future of space exploration.
